attchmntText: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited filed the transcript of its earnings conference call for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported its first full quarter as a unified entity following the merger with Quality Care. Revenue grew 19% year-on-year to INR 2,829 crore. Operating EBITDA increased 25% to INR 678 crore with an operating margin of 24%. Normalised profit after tax rose 34%. The company served 2.2 million patients, a 12% increase. It delivered INR 16.6 crore in synergies this quarter. The annualized synergy run-rate is approximately INR 65 crore. The pipeline includes 4,230 additional beds, raising total capacity from 10,840 to over 15,000. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and NSE on 13 November 2026.

attchmntText: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding dispatch of the Notice of Postal Ballot of the Company
voiceSummary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited published a newspaper advertisement on 13 November 2026 confirming the completion of dispatch of the Notice of Postal Ballot through Email. The notice was published in Financial Express and Andhra Jyothi. Muthoot Microfin Limited filed unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Total income from operations was 79,424.29 lakhs. Net profit after tax was 16,646.78 lakhs. Earnings per share was 121.24. Debt equity ratio was 4.95 times. Net worth was 1,30,937.55 lakhs. Tata Power Company Limited invited expressions of interest for the supply of hot, intermediate, and cold end GAB baskets at the Mundra Thermal Power Station. The deadline for submission was 23 November 2026.

attchmntText: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for the appointment of Ms. Neela Bhattacherjee, DIN 01912483, as a Non-Executive Independent Director. The resolution is subject to member approval via remote e-voting. The voting period commences on 13 November 2026 at 09:00 AM IST and concludes on 12 December 2026 at 05:00 PM IST. If approved, Ms. Bhattacherjee will hold office for three consecutive years from 28 September 2026 to 27 September 2029. Her remuneration is capped at Rs. 40,00,000 per annum. Mr. Rajiv Balakrishnan has been appointed as the Scrutinizer for the process. The final results, along with the Scrutinizer’s report, will be communicated to stock exchanges within two working days from the conclusion of the e-voting.
